title: EMI Calculator
description: Calculate your loan EMI easily with our free EMI calculator. Plan your loan better and manage your finances smartly.

faqs.question: How is EMI calculated?
faqs.answer: EMI is calculated using the formula EMI = [P × r × (1+r)^n] / [(1+r)^n − 1], where P is principal, r is the monthly interest rate, and n is the tenure in months.

faqs.question: Does EMI change during the loan tenure?
faqs.answer: For a fixed-rate loan, the EMI stays the same throughout the tenure, though the split between principal and interest changes each month.

faqs.question: What happens if I prepay my loan?
faqs.answer: Prepayment reduces the outstanding principal, which lowers either your EMI or your remaining tenure, depending on what your lender offers.
